messages.subject: Imputing categorical data
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to create imputed data and to analyze this using the logit extension?

My two outcomes are categorical and whenever I try running my analysis, Lavaan automatically deletes all but the complete cases.

I tried generating imputed data using MICE and connecting this to my SEM model in lavaan, however this has not worked for me so far.

Is it even possible to compute these missing data or is it only possible to use complete data?

Thank you!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Imputing categorical data
parts: My two outcomes are categorical and whenever I try running my analysis, Lavaan automatically deletes all but the complete cases.

The default is listwise deletion, but you can set missing = "pairwise" when using (DW/U)LS estimation, as well as estimator = "PML" (although a less restrictive, more computationally intensive alternative is available using PML: missing = "doubly.robust").

https://doi.org/10.1111/bmsp.12243 (read more about PML here)
I tried generating imputed data using MICE and connecting this to my SEM model in lavaan, however this has not worked for me so far.

With multiple imputations, you need to use the semTools package, which has functionality for lavaan.mi objects (see the ?runMI help page for examples, and class?lavaan.mi for more information).
